See what works. Act on it faster.

2human builds and runs the marketing tools, websites and apps that help organizations find out what their customers value, deliver it, and build what works into how they operate.

Why we do this

Most teams don't lack tools. They lack a simple way to see what is working and act on it quickly.

We set up and run the pieces, from the website to the CRM to the reports, so that this becomes the normal way of working, not something that depends on people staying late.

How it works

Four tracks, running side by side.

Not phases, one after another. All four run for as long as we work together, and every round starts from what the last one taught us.

01

Discovery

Start from what you already know.

  • An honest look at what you have: site, campaigns, data
  • What you know about your customers, and what you are still guessing
  • Each round begins with what the last one taught us
02

Delivery

Build what reaches people.

  • Websites, campaigns, emails and tools, built and launched
  • Measurement built in from the first day
  • Changes made in hours, not weeks
03

Validation

Let your audience decide.

  • What visitors and customers actually do, measured
  • What they tell you, collected
  • Clear calls on what to keep and what to drop
04

Integration

Keep what works.

  • What proves itself becomes part of your site, sales and service
  • What does not is retired, not carried along
  • Each round leaves you a little stronger
What we build

Martech, websites and apps.

We work across all three, so they work together instead of side by side.

Martech

Reach the right people, and know it worked.

Analytics, CRM, email, ads and social media, set up properly and kept running, with reports that show what each effort brings in.

  • Analytics and tracking
  • CRM set-up and clean-up
  • Ads, email and social campaigns
  • Simple, regular reports

Web

Where people decide to get in touch.

Fast, clear websites and landing pages that are easy to change, built on technology you own.

  • Websites and landing pages
  • Moving off website builders
  • Testing what turns visitors into enquiries
  • Easy to find, good to share

Apps

Less manual work, everything in one place.

Team hubs, internal tools and assistants that take care of routine work and keep information where everyone can find it.

  • Team and client hubs
  • Internal tools

  • Connecting the tools you already use
How we work

Simple, steady, and yours.

1

Proven building blocks

Every project starts from what already works elsewhere, so you see results sooner and pay less.

2

Smart tools, human judgement

We use AI to do more in less time. A person checks and approves everything before it goes live.

3

Everything stays yours

Your website, data and accounts belong to you. No lock-in, to a platform or to us.

4

Your team, stronger

We work alongside your people and leave clear notes, so you can keep going without us.

Who we work with

Agencies, businesses and causes.

Agencies

We work behind the scenes for agencies: building sites, running campaigns and setting up CRMs under their name, while they look after their clients.

Businesses

Growing teams with too many tools and spreadsheets, who want marketing, website and operations to work together.

Civic and community

Movements, institutions and communities that need to reach people and organise well, on a tight budget.

Who we are

2human is founded and run by Miloš Milosavljević, with more than twenty years in product, communication and helping organizations change.

Miloš Milosavljević

Digital Strategist and Product Leader

20+ years of experience across journalism, media, non-profit, SaaS, HR tech, and B2B. He has helped design and scale platforms, products, and campaigns that require both narrative precision and solid technical thinking, while keeping teams aligned on clear intent and measurable outcomes. Clients value Miloš for three things: a systems mindset that connects architecture, product, communications, and user/customer experience; an ability to translate complex ideas into clear, resonant language; and a mentoring style that develops people as much as it delivers projects. At 2human, he anchors the work in continuous discovery, crisp positioning, and go-to-market clarity, ensuring learning travels from market signals to product decisions and execution. In 2025, he co-founded (with others) Odvaž, contributing to learning spaces and civic initiatives that keep his practice grounded in real-world systems.

Questions

Questions we often hear

Do you work with agencies?

Yes. Much of our work is for agencies, under their name. They keep the client relationship, and we make sure the work gets done well.

Who owns what you build?

You do. The website, the data and the accounts are yours, and we leave everything documented.

Do you use AI?

Yes, to work faster and keep costs down. A person reviews everything before it reaches your customers.

Where do we start?

With an honest look at what you already have: your website, campaigns, data and the way you talk to customers. We keep what works, fix what causes the most trouble first, and build from there.

Contact

What would you like to work better?

Tell us a little about where you are and what you would like to change. We will reply with a suggestion for the first step.

We typically respond within 24 hours.
